name: 50208 · Newton, IA
findings: ZIP 50208 (Newton) has 100 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 50208 (Newton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
39% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 50208 (Newton) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 37% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 59% of all organizations here have no identified type.
